mapper.select: SELECT s.*, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM grade g WHERE g.school_id = s.id AND g.deleted = 0) AS grade_count, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM teacher t WHERE t.school_id = s.id AND t.deleted = 0) AS teacher_count, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM student st WHERE st.school_id = s.id AND st.deleted = 0) AS student_count FROM school s WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.deleted = 0
